name: Beauté rapprochée
creativeDirectionSummary: High-resolution studio beauty editorial in a 4:5 vertical portrait, framed tightly from the upper chest to just above the slicked-back hair. The consenting adult model faces nearly forward with a slight turn, a subtly raised chin, relaxed closed lips, and a calm gaze directly toward the camera. She wears a matte black, softly draped high-neck garment and one prominent polished-gold sculptural earring visible on frame right. A warm, hard directional key from high camera-left shapes the face with crisp highlights, controlled cheek and neck shadows, and warm metallic reflections against a seamless near-black background. The tonal character is warm, contrast-rich, minimally retouched, and editorial, retaining visible skin texture and deep blacks.

visualDNA.sceneComposition: Use a seamless, featureless near-black studio background with no visible horizon, props, furniture, architecture, pattern, or environmental detail. Construct a tight upper-chest beauty crop in vertical 4:5 orientation. The lower frame cuts through the upper torso; both shoulders extend toward or beyond the side edges. Include the complete face, ears where visible, neck, high collar, and the full slicked-back hair silhouette, leaving only narrow black headroom above the highest hair strands. The head and upper torso occupy approximately 85-90 percent of the frame height. Place the face close to center with the head slightly toward frame right, leaving modest negative space at frame left. Preserve the asymmetrical shoulder crop and do not widen into a conventional bust portrait.
visualDNA.cameraGeometry: Camera positioned approximately at mouth-to-lower-eye height with a nearly level axis and a very slight upward impression created by the raised chin; no Dutch angle and no perspective correction that changes the reference construction. Use a short-telephoto beauty-portrait lens feel, approximately 85-105 mm full-frame equivalent, at close portrait distance, with mild perspective compression and no wide-angle facial distortion. Render the eyes, brows, nose, lips, earrings, and facial skin sharply. Use moderate depth of field: the facial plane is crisp while rear hair and the black garment soften subtly without becoming blurred or dreamy. Preserve a high-resolution editorial capture with natural optical detail rather than artificial oversharpening.
visualDNA.poseExpression: Keep the torso nearly frontal with a slight turn toward frame left. Rotate the face only subtly off-axis toward frame left while maintaining a nearly frontal presentation. Hold the head upright with minimal tilt and raise the chin slightly. Keep shoulders low and relaxed, with the frame-left shoulder appearing marginally lower. Direct both eyes toward the camera with a steady, composed, self-possessed gaze. Keep eyelids naturally relaxed and slightly narrowed. Lips are gently closed or separated by only a hairline opening, jaw relaxed, expression neutral and controlled. No smile, pout, exaggerated intensity, open mouth, visible teeth, hand gesture, or hands within the crop.
visualDNA.hairStyling: Style the future model's own hair compatibly with her identity and natural hair characteristics. Create a wet-look, slicked-back construction with no visible part, swept away from the forehead and temples. Maintain controlled combed-back ridges, low-to-moderate crown volume, subtle individual wet strands, and compact hair behind the ears and down the back. Hair should look damp and glossy rather than oily, helmet-like, or artificially molded. Do not alter the hairline or use the hairstyle to change recognizable facial anatomy.
visualDNA.wardrobeAccessories: Dress the model in an opaque matte-black high-neck garment with a close, softly draped funnel or turtleneck collar. The collar fully covers the neck to just below the jaw and forms several broad, continuous diagonal and horizontal folds. Continue the same black fabric over the shoulders and upper chest. The silhouette is minimal, modest, uninterrupted, and tone-on-tone with the background. Fabric is dense, nontransparent, nonreflective, and softly structured, with continuous seams and plausible drape. Add a large polished yellow-gold sculptural knot or intertwined-loop earring to the clearly visible ear on frame right. The earring consists of coherent interlocking rounded metal bands, sits naturally on the earlobe, and catches warm highlights. If the opposite earring is hidden by angle, hair, or crop, do not force it into view. No necklace, eyewear, headwear, or additional visible accessories.
visualDNA.referenceMakeup: Apply restrained warm-neutral editorial makeup without changing the model's facial anatomy. Use light-to-medium complexion coverage with a natural satin finish, preserving pores, fine texture, realistic tonal variation, and small authentic skin details. Groom brows upward and outward with moderate definition while retaining the future model's natural brow anatomy and density. Use softly blended warm taupe and muted bronze eyeshadow over the lids and subtly beneath the lower lash line, with gentle depth at the outer corners. Keep eyeliner extremely fine and close to the upper lashes, without a prominent graphic wing. Define lashes with believable separated volume and modest extension, not dense false-lash fans. Apply understated warm terracotta or muted peach-brown blush across the cheeks, minimal natural contour, and restrained highlight created mainly by the physical key light. Use a nude rose-brown lip color with softly defined natural edges and a satin-to-subtle-gloss finish; retain the model's natural lip shape and avoid overlining. Overall cosmetic intensity is polished but restrained, intended to clarify features under a hard beauty light. Preserve realistic skin beneath makeup; no mask-like foundation, plastic smoothing, identity-changing contour, malformed eyeliner, or implausible lashes.
visualDNA.lightingArchitecture: Reproduce a physically plausible studio system dominated by one warm, relatively hard key light from high camera-left, approximately the 10 o'clock direction and 25-35 degrees above eye level. Use a small-to-medium apparent source, producing defined but not razor-edged transitions. The key strikes the forehead, bridge and tip of the nose, upper cheeks, lips, chin, and frame-left facial planes most strongly. It creates warm specular highlights on the forehead, nose, cheekbones, lower lip, damp hair ridges, and gold earring. The nose casts a compact shadow downward and slightly toward frame right. Preserve controlled shadow under the brows, nose, lower lip, jaw, and high collar. The jaw casts a dense shadow onto the upper neck and collar, while the frame-right cheek and temple fall into moderately deeper sculpting shadow. The ear and gold earring at frame right remain legible through reflected key light. Keep the background effectively black and at least 3-4 stops darker than the illuminated face. Use only minimal ambient or passive fill, approximately a 4:1 to 6:1 key-to-fill relationship, sufficient to retain natural facial detail without lifting the black background or flattening facial structure. No visible rim light, halo, backlight, catchlight strip, or extra frontal beauty fill. Cast shadows and highlights must agree with this single dominant source.
visualDNA.exposureSpecular: Prioritize exposure for facial skin. Preserve bright forehead, cheek, nose, and lip highlights without broad clipping; allow tiny point reflections on wet hair and polished gold to approach or reach clean specular white. Keep shadows deep but not crushed across important facial anatomy. The black garment should retain faint fold separation near the collar and shoulders while merging progressively into the background. Skin has natural satin sheen, not wet, oily, pearlescent, or airbrushed. Gold is glossy and warmly reflective; fabric remains matte. Maintain natural highlight roll-off, firm local contrast, and a deep black point. Do not add HDR recovery, shadow lifting, glow, bloom, halation, or invented fill.
visualDNA.colorTreatment: Use a warm-neutral key and white balance with honey-gold skin highlights, warm brown midtones, muted terracotta cosmetic accents, polished yellow-gold jewelry, rich dark hair, and neutral deep blacks. Keep saturation restrained to moderate, with warmth concentrated in the illuminated skin and metal rather than applied as a global orange wash. Preserve strong subject-to-background separation through exposure and warm color contrast, not rim lighting. Shadows remain neutral-to-warm brown rather than blue or teal. No orange-and-teal grade, cool cinematic shadows, faded blacks, pastel treatment, or excessive saturation.
visualDNA.facialObjectCoherence: Preserve coherent iris size, centered pupil placement, matching gaze direction, natural eyelid structure, and correct perspective asymmetry. Keep continuous natural lip contours and plausible mouth closure. Maintain correctly attached ears and a physically anchored earring. The visible earring must have continuous metal loops, correct occlusion, believable weight, and no duplication or intersection with skin or hair. Preserve continuous shoulders, jaw, neck, and garment contact. Do not invent tattoos, scars, birthmarks, or identity marks from the artistic reference; reproduce such traits only if supported by the uploaded identity photographs, with correct body side, position, orientation, scale, and occlusion. Hands and feet are outside the crop and must not be introduced.
visualDNA.photographicFinish: Produce a real high-resolution studio beauty photograph with crisp eyes and facial detail, realistic pores, fine facial hairs, subtle natural asymmetry, controlled microcontrast, and restrained professional retouching. Remove only accidental generation artifacts while retaining the original hard-light architecture, exposure hierarchy, black-background composition, tight crop, wet-look hair, wardrobe construction, expression, and warm editorial character. No automatic relighting, HDR, fill light, skin beautification, cinematic reinterpretation, or composition correction.

runtimeSignature.genre: Luxury high-fashion beauty editorial; warm, contrast-rich, minimally retouched.
runtimeSignature.framing: Tight 4:5, not macro; full head, exposed ear + full EARRING; neck/shoulders visible; no clipping.
runtimeSignature.camera: 85–105 mm short telephoto; mild compression; crisp facial plane; no wide angle.
runtimeSignature.background: Seamless near-black background; no props, architecture, horizon or backlight.
runtimeSignature.pose: Near frontal, slight turn frame-left; chin subtly raised; relaxed shoulders.
runtimeSignature.expression: Direct composed gaze; no smile; relaxed narrowed eyelids; closed neutral lips.
runtimeSignature.hair: Wet-look slicked-back, no part, off forehead/temples, behind ears; one ear exposed.
runtimeSignature.styling: yellow-gold sculptural EARRING on exposed ear; precious-metal weight/specular depth, never painted/plastic/costume; matte-black high-neck garment.
runtimeSignature.lighting: Warm camera-left luxury key; sculpted face, protected highlights, precise gold reflections; no blunt flash/rim.
runtimeSignature.finish: Real pores, rich blacks, restrained exposure; no blown highlights, cheap gloss, HDR/smoothing.
runtimeSignature.makeup: Restrained warm-neutral editorial makeup; satin real skin, subtle warm eyes, natural brows/lashes, nude rose-brown lip.
